# Chinmaya IAS Academy Current Affairs

> > A comprehensive current affairs platform providing daily news analysis and editorial insights for UPSC civil services examination preparation, covering government policy, economy, judiciary, and national issues.

Chinmaya IAS Academy's current affairs portal offers curated news articles from The Hindu and other sources, focusing on topics critical for IAS aspirants including Supreme Court judgments, economic policies, India-Pakistan relations, and governance issues. The content emphasizes analytical understanding of contemporary events with relevance to the civil services examination.

## Key Topics

- UPSC Civil Services Preparation
- Supreme Court Judgments
- India Economy & GDP
- Government Policy & Schemes
- Kashmir Conflict & India-Pakistan Relations
- Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Policies
- GST & Taxation
- Centre-State Relations
- Disaster Management
- Social Justice & SC/ST Issues
- Judiciary & Constitutional Matters
- Kerala Floods & Emergency Response
- Historical Editorials Analysis
- Economic Indicators (WPI, Inflation)
- Governance & Public Administration

## Economy & Finance

- [Growth may pick up, but concerns remain](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/growth-may-pick-up-but-concerns-remain): India's GDP forecast, RBI projections, and concerns on job creation
- [GST revenue in July rises to Rs. 96,483 cr.](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/gst-revenue-in-july-rises-to-rs-96483-cr): GST revenue rises to Rs 96,483 cr in July 2018 from GSTR 3B returns
- [e-way bill made mandatory for inter-State goods movement](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/e-way-bill-made-mandatory-for-inter-state-goods-movement): GST Council mandates e-way bill for inter-state goods in Kerala
- [WPI inflation slows to 5.09% in July](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/wpi-inflation-slows-to-5-09-in-july): Wholesale Price Index inflation eases to 5.09% in July from food prices
- [Cabinet okays 51% stake for LIC in IDBI](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/cabinet-okays-51-stake-for-lic-in-idbi): Union Cabinet approves LIC acquiring 51% stake in IDBI Bank
- [Credit registry: RBI Act may need tweak](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/credit-registry-rbi-act-may-need-tweak): RBI Act 1934 may need amendment for Public Credit Registry implementation
- [Adani emerges biggest winner of city gas licences](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/adani-emerges-biggest-winner-of-city-gas-licences): Adani Gas wins most CGD licenses for CNG and piped natural gas retail

## Government Policy & Schemes

- [PM healthcare scheme from Sept. 25](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/pm-healthcare-scheme-from-sept-25): PM Modi announces PMJAA healthcare scheme launch from Sept 25
- [Centre pushes for quota in promotion for SCs/STs](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/centre-pushes-for-quota-in-promotion-for-scs-sts): Centre seeks SC/ST promotion quota review of M. Nagaraj judgment
- [New norms against plagiarism](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/new-norms-against-plagiarism): UGC introduces 2018 regulations for academic integrity and plagiarism

- [A-G lashes out at riots, intolerance](https://currentaffairs.chinmayaias.com/a-g-lashes-out-at-riots-intolerance): Attorney General K.K. Venugopal condemns riots and intolerance at SC
